note: Majority: read from the Code of Childhood and Adolescence (Código de la Niñez y Adolescencia, Law 2002-100, in force 3 July 2003; the Registro Civil's copy, Ediciones Legales edition of 2013), articles 2 and 4: the Code protects every person until eighteen, and an adolescent is a person between twelve and eighteen. The Civil Code's own article 21 ('mayor de edad, el que ha cumplido dieciocho años') wasn't found on an official site; holding eighteen from the children's code is a reading. Work: article 82 sets fifteen as the minimum age for every kind of work, including domestic service, save the Code's exceptions; article 86 exempts only ancestral formative practices within the adolescent's community, and article 93 has municipalities permit self-employment from fifteen. Performers: the Code names no exception for a child performer, so a performer under fifteen is held as barred: a reading of the letter of article 82, to check against any regulation of the Ministry of Labour or the former National Council for Childhood and Adolescence on child actors, which wasn't found. Hours limits (article 84, six a day) are not held. Service: the Constitution of 2008 (Registro Oficial 449 of 20 October 2008, as last amended 25 January 2021), article 161: civic-military service is voluntary.

sources.title: Registro Civil del Ecuador: Código de la Niñez y Adolescencia (Ley 2002-100), with related laws
sources.said: Las normas del presente Código son aplicables a todo ser humano, desde su concepción hasta que cumpla dieciocho años de edad. ... Adolescente es la persona de ambos sexos entre doce y dieciocho años ... Art. 82.- Edad mínima para el trabajo. Se fija en quince años la edad mínima para todo tipo de trabajo, incluido el servicio doméstico, con las salvedades previstas en este Código
